description: In pkix-lint/src/lib.rs line 134, the de_static_str helper leaks one heap allocation per unique deserialized LintResult detail string. The documentation is thorough (lines 116-130), but there is no runtime protection against misuse in long-running services. A reasonable mitigation — at minimum a compile-time #[cfg] guard, a feature gate, or a bounded LRU interning table — would prevent silent OOM in daemon processes. The current design relies entirely on the caller reading the doc comment. This is a P2 API design issue, not just a style note.
title: de_static_str memory leak in long-running services has no runtime guard or metric
